from.place: The LM₀ suboperad used in the restriction to an algebra and an independent object in the proof of Proposition 4.2.4.2.

title: The LM₀ suboperad of the left-module operad
statement: Use the ordered left-module operad `LM^⊗` and its finite ordered fibres from [def-coef-left-module-operadic-encoding]. Define `LM₀^⊗` to have all the same objects and exactly those operations for which every module-coloured output has a singleton ordered fibre consisting of its unique module-coloured input; inputs sent to the basepoint remain unrestricted. Substitution and identities are inherited, so this is a wide subcategory and its nerve `LM₀^⊗` includes into `LM^⊗`. The module-colour object and its vertex in the nerve are retained.
